description: This Java class defines the 'Note' entity for a note-taking application, including fields for title, content, tags, and timestamps, along with JPA annotations for persistence.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing a note with title, content, tags, and timestamps, mapped to the 'notes' table.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets createdAt and updatedAt timestamps to current time upon entity creation.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates the updatedAt timestamp to current time upon entity update.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the note.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the note.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns the tags associated with the note.

methods.name: setTags
methods.description: Sets the tags for the note.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the note's ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the note's ID.
